author: How It Should Have Ended
description:
Yoshi's is introduced to the Super Mario Galaxy but to the "I like To Party" scene from Hot Rod.
So what's up with this mashup? I've always loved Lonely Island all the way back to the Awesome Town days.  They are not only hilarious, but their early low budget indie style work has always inspired me as a content creator. From writing comedy, to scene pacing, even to just pushing yourself to keep making shorts. It's safe to say they have always been a source of influence over the years while creating cartoons and skit ideas. So #quaidarmy 

In anticipation of the Super Mario Bros sequel I started thinking about what Mario games would they likely not even bother referencing in this vast new movie world.  That's when Mario Party jumped out, and given my love for Hot Rod my brain immediately went to "I like to party"  And just like that I was giggling at the idea of what if this scene was Mario characters. 

Let us know if you like the mashup concept.  Maybe I could make more from my favor
title: Mario Likes to Party - Hot Rod and Super Mario Mashup
